text.text_excerpt: A great place for a quick, weekday breakfast date. I appreciate their early hours and wide variety of fast and absurdly delicious savory breakfast options. (The muffins and other sweet stuff look plenty good, but I go for eggs and biscuits myself.) I love that they have Counter Culture Coffee - good stuff. They made this small space infinitely more inviting. An excellent addition to the neighborhood.

I thought of this place as just another hipster coffee place until i recently went for a quick breakfast. They really know their coffee and the staff was patient and helpful. I ended up with the shockproof coffee since it is a specialty of theirs. The healthy oils in the coffee made for a smooth mouthfeel but it made your lips feel like to kissed a thigh of a fried chicken. It did its job and woke me up and, as advertised, I did not have a crash later in the morning. My wife ordered the bacon and cheddar scone and I had the dom sandwich. The dom was a great sandwich but the scone was amazing.

It's been three years since I first tried HiVolt Coffee. As I was doing some Black Friday shopping in the area, I stumbled upon HiVolt Bakery- same coffee and this spot serves breakfast sandwiches and other noms. I gotta say- my experience here was a lot better than my last at the other location. I stopped in to grab an iced coffee to go. The woman working was very nice and completed my order quickly. This shop is a bit small, but I like the ambiance and it doesn't feel as "sterile" as the other location. The coffee was pretty good and I liked that I didn't have to add anything to it and I could just enjoy the coffee flavor minus the milk. I didn't get anything to eat this time, but HiVol...
